profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 63 (Liquid Web missing-address campaign): applied 2703 Ena Drive as this rows likely address, derived from a facility specific aggregator listing cross corroborated by reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a separate third party service, both agreeing on street number and street name, and by matching aggregator listed square footage and headquarters designation against this operators own stated Data Center B size.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Liquid Web is a privately held web hosting and cloud services company headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, founded in 1997. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This operators own site describes two Lansing area data centers, Data Center A at 32,000 square feet with capacity for 8,000 servers, and Data Center B at 90,000 square feet with capacity for 25,000 servers, but does not publish street addresses for either. This session found a facility specific aggregator listing naming three Lansing facilities with street addresses, DC1 at 4210 South Creyts Road, DC2 at 4428 South Creyts Road, and DC3 at 2703 Ena Drive, the latter identified as headquarters and described as a 90,000 square foot facility with 50,000 square feet of whitespace. Reverse geocoding this rows own independently stored coordinates through a separate third party geocoding service returned 2703 Ena, matching the aggregators DC3 address exactly by street number and street name. Given DC3s aggregator listed size, 90,000 square feet, matches this operators own stated Data Center B size exactly, and both sources agree this is the headquarters building, this address is applied to this row as the likely Data Center B building with reasonable confidence, corroborated by two independent methods, though the underlying street address itself is not published on this operators own site directly. The aggregators separately listed DC1 address does not match either of this registrys two Liquid Web rows and is not applied to any row.

reading.body:
Liquid Web operates a 90,000 square foot facility in Lansing, Michigan with stated capacity for 25,000 servers. The campus has a 13,500 kVA utility power feed across two buildings, though the operator does not publish IT load in megawatts. Assuming 5 kW per server, a conservative estimate for general hosting workloads, this would imply roughly 125 MW of IT demand if fully populated, but the actual power allocation between the two buildings and the proportion dedicated to compute versus supporting infrastructure is not published.

Michigan has six mapped data center facilities and no other published power capacity figures in this site's records, making Liquid Web's Lansing campus the only facility in the state with a disclosed power specification. The facility is located at the operator's headquarters and has been expanded to its current configuration, though growth trajectory and planned capacity additions are not published.

The campus is configured for general hosting and cloud services rather than GPU-intensive AI training based on the server count specification. No certifications for specific workload types are published on the operator's spec page. Whether this facility will matter to AI scaling depends on whether the operator adds published power figures and on whether compute density per rack increases toward levels required for large model training.
